name: Darkshire Town Hall
summary: Darkshire Town Hall anchors a town besieged by darkness and undead. Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke and his council govern from its dim halls.

sections.title: The Seat of Darkshire
sections.body: Darkshire Town Hall stands just west of the main square, where the town's leaders meet to govern an increasingly isolated territory. Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke struggles to keep order and protect the people while Stormwind sends little military aid. Clerk Daltry and other officials track town records and the travelers who brave Duskwood's dangerous roads. With danger all around, keeping those ledgers current is a grim task.

faq.q: Who leads the town from this building?
aliases: who is in the town hall
faq.answer: Lord Ello Ebonlocke leads Darkshire as its mayor and presides over the town council from the Town Hall. He directs local defenses and appeals to visiting adventurers for help, since the town receives almost no reinforcements from Stormwind.

faq.q: What records are kept inside the Town Hall?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry keeps town registries of residents and travelers passing through Darkshire. Chaos and frequent dangers in Duskwood have left many of his records out of date.

faq.q: Why is the Town Hall so important to Duskwood's survival?
aliases: why does the town hall matter
faq.answer: With Duskwood cut off from direct military support from Stormwind, the Town Hall is the working center for the Night Watch and local authorities. The council coordinates civilian defense and sends aid across the shadowy region.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers, the Town Hall reflects the fragile authority of the kingdom's southern frontier and the limits of Stormwind's protection in isolated settlements.
